view.title: O1 Pipeline - End-to-end flow
view.caption: The end-to-end pipeline as a process flow. The authoring arm (A0 -> A1 -> A2 -> ASH-Capture -> locator resolution -> code gen) is LLM-bounded; the spine (static gate -> device gate -> verdict) is LLM-free and consumes only committed artifacts. Two bounded loops: static-gate repair and ASH-Capture discovery. The flywheel closes the loop on accept. ASH-Capture stages are PROPOSED (ADR 0014 in flight).

nodes.label: A0 Normalizer (LLM)
detail: PROPOSED this session
free-form English / manual script -> NormalizedIntent
does NOT produce TestCaseIR; F1 flywheel does not apply
concrete mocks: NormalizedIntent.input.txt -> NormalizedIntent.prompt.md -> NormalizedIntent.json

nodes.label: A1 Parser (deterministic)
detail: structure only; splits into N steps, raw intent per step
does NOT fill action/locator/assertion/controlFlow
concrete mock: TestCaseIR.skeleton.json

nodes.label: A2 Semantic Interpreter
detail: deterministic-first, LLM fallback
expands steps, normalizes navigation, extracts loops, flags ambiguity
emits committed TestCaseIR.json
concrete mock: TestCaseIR.json (the committed handoff to the spine)

nodes.label: ASH-Capture
detail: PROPOSED ADR 0014
drives app to screenContext, dumps hierarchy (pageSource + pruned + objectSpy)
commits NavigationManifest + ScreenGraph edges
concrete mocks: ASHCapture.discovery.*, ASHCapture.deeplink.*, ASHCapture.driftrepair.input.json; see 05-discovery-loop for the internal runtime cycle

nodes.label: Locator resolution
detail: deterministic cascade: accessibility id > id > class chain > xpath
sources: OBJECT_REPO > PAGE_SOURCE > OBJECT_SPY > VLM > LLM-guess
emits LocatorCandidate.manifest.json
concrete mocks: LocatorResolution.fallback.{input.json,prompt.md,output.json} (the LLM fallback path); see 06-locator-cascade for the full cascade

nodes.label: Code generation (LLM, offline)
detail: IR + manifest -> Appium Java (page objects, BaseTest)
credentials via vault() calls, never literals
emits committed LoginTest.java (the audit pin)
concrete mock: LoginTest.java

nodes.label: Static gate
detail: THE SPINE BEGINS - LLM-free from here
format, mvn compile, Checkstyle, Error Prone, locator-manifest rule
FAIL -> loop back to code gen (bounded)
concrete mock: StaticGate.report.json

nodes.label: Device gate
detail: Perfecto; K=1 signed-off baseline (K=3/5 weeks-3-8+ target - raising K is a CF6 recorded decision)
flakiness: STABLE / FLAKY / UNKNOWN

nodes.label: Verdict (ReplayReport)
detail: pins codeCommit SHA (the audit pin)
verdict CERTIFIED only if static PASS + device STABLE
healsApplied: NONE (spine does not self-heal)
concrete mock: ReplayReport.json

nodes.label: Human evaluator
detail: validates result against original input intent
PASS -> flywheel; FAIL -> loop back to A0 with error

nodes.label: Flywheel
detail: accepted locators -> object repository
accepted exemplars -> prompt library
accept/reject labels -> preference training data (O6 ensemble)

edges.label: FAIL -> loop back with error + intent
